simple.meaning: שְׁוָה (shᵉvâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to resemble.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 3:29. Its contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁוָה (H7739).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שְׁוָה (shᵉvâh) / H7739 is traced through Daniel 3:29, Daniel 5:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Therefore I make a decree, that every people, nation, and language, which speak anything evil against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill; because there is no other god who is able to deliver like this.”

majorEvents.label: Genealogy
majorEvents.evidenceText: He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky; until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

definitions.full: H7739. shvah II. [ שְׁוָה ] verb Hithpa. be set, made (Pa`el שַׁוִּי make , Cappadocian Aramaic Lzb Eph. i. 67 ; compare Biblical Hebrew II. [ שָׁוָה ]); — Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׁתַּוֵּה֑ Dan 3:29 , subject of thing + accusative be made into something (K § 84, 3 ).
